AppSettings.title: AppSettings
AppSettings.description: Configuration for Monetag ads, multiple direct links, daily ad cap, Telegram bot token, and Telegram channel username.

monetagCode.description: Monetag ad script or zone code

directLinks.description: List of direct links rotated on user click

dailyAdLimit.description: Maximum number of times ads are shown per user per day

botToken.description: Telegram Bot API token for channel membership verification

requireChannelJoin.description: Whether users must join the Telegram channel before launching Windows

updatedBy.description: Email of the admin who updated the settings

/config/{configId}.description: Application configuration document modified only by verified admin.
